note: Hand-maintained. Every hard-coded ('legacy') rule in health/rules.js, mapped to the workbook rule(s) that define the same or the nearest condition, with what differs. `relation`: duplicate (same condition), subset (legacy is a narrower case), superset (legacy fires more broadly than the workbook allows), per_record_of_rate (legacy charges individual records for a condition the workbook defines as an estate rate), different_condition (a related but different question), none (no workbook counterpart). `code_severity` is what rules.js asserts; `workbook_severity` is the counterpart's base. `disposition` is the agreed end state and `effective_phase` when it takes effect (docs/HEALTH-ASSIST-APPROACH.md §3.3, §12). Nothing here changes behaviour in Phase 0.

dispositions.retire_from_scoring: Stops charging or counting in any score; kept only as a drill-down view under its workbook owner rule, if useful.
dispositions.replace_when_built: Interim stand-in until the workbook rule is built; then retired. Unscored and labelled interim from the phase stated.
dispositions.applicability_evidence: Becomes an input to a deterministic applicability probe (approach §6), not a scored rule.

differences: Fires when owned_by alone is empty; CMDB-105 requires owner, manager AND support group all empty, with the field set per class.
Does not evaluate an inactive owner (CMDB-103).
Fixed 90 days since sys_updated_on (global staleDays); CMDB-075 is 'no update of any kind since creation' at 180 days; CMDB-072 is last_discovered beyond the schedule's own interval × 2.
Groups by serial within the same class only; CMDB-035 is any serial duplicate, excluding placeholders and serials on more than N CIs.
Any CI with no edge; CMDB-058 scopes to principal classes expected to have relationships.
Already skipped at run time as 'subsumed by CMDB-058' while Group 6 is built.
A self-referencing edge is the length-1 case of a circular chain.
Already skipped at run time as subsumed while Group 6 is built.
Already skipped at run time as subsumed while Group 6 is built.
Service owned_by empty; CMDB-105 is the per-class owner/manager/support-group rule.
No workbook rule checks an empty life_cycle_stage on services. Nearest family: Group 8 (lifecycle).
No workbook rule checks for a business service with no offering. Group 11 judges reachability and association, not offerings.
Open incident with no assignment group; ITSM-042 is assignment to an individual rather than a group (a ratio); ITSM-004 is assignment rules absent.
itsm-quality.js treats it and ITSM-042 as one defect family (incident_unassigned) on measured record overlap.
P1 open more than 1 day; ITSM-037 is backlog ageing by priority with defaults 2 days P1, 5 days P2, 15 days P3.
Open incident not updated for 30 days (idle time); ITSM-037 measures age since creation by priority.
Charges every open incident with no CI and no service; ITSM-016 is the percentage of such incidents against a 40% threshold over a 90-day window.
Charges each incident reopened two or more times; ITSM-030 is the reopen rate by group and resolution code, 8%, escalating at 15%.
No workbook rule for an open change idle for 30 days. ITSM-100 (planned dates absent or past at approval) is the nearest.
Charges each open change with no CI; ITSM-094 is the percentage of changes with no CI and no service against 30%.
Open past its planned end date; ITSM-111 is implemented outside its approved window. The Phase 5 closure measured them as different signals.
Charges each change closed unsuccessful; ITSM-113 is the success rate against 90%; ITSM-114 is a failed change with no backout.
Open problem with no assignment group; ITSM-065 is a problem with no assigned owner, or an inactive owner.
Open problem idle 30 days; ITSM-061 is open beyond 90 days with no state change; ITSM-056 is never progressed past the initial state (30 days).

The workbook assumes MID servers exist. Their absence is applicability evidence: with no MID and no Discovery evidence the MID dimension is not applicable; with Discovery evidence it is in use and broken.
Status = Down only; ITOM-053 also counts degraded status and last refresh beyond 3× the heartbeat interval. Lives in platformRules() but routes to ITOM.
Any unvalidated MID not Down; ITOM-055 is limited to MIDs in production use.
Any MID with no capability; ITOM-062 requires the MID to be referenced by schedules.
Any unresolved issue; ITOM-059 is an issue count rising over at least 3 observation points (a trend).
discovery_status empty; ITOM-003 is no schedule for a datacentre or region present in the CMDB. An empty status table is applicability evidence.
Any errored or cancelled run; ITOM-032 needs errors on more than 10% of devices, ITOM-033 a run not completing in its window, ITOM-039 a cancelled run never re-run.
Last completion older than a fixed 90 days; ITOM-006 is last success beyond the schedule's own interval × 2 (guard: deliberately paused). A daily schedule failing for 30 days passes today's rule.
Any device-history row with issues > 0; the workbook splits by phase: halted at port scan, classified but not explored, discovered but no CI.
Any single error-level log row; ITOM-038 is error volume trending up over at least 5 runs (guard: verbosity changed).
Credential table empty; ITOM-016 is no credential of the required type for a range containing devices of that type. An empty table is also applicability evidence.
Any inactive credential; ITOM-018 requires the credential to be inactive or expired AND still referenced by a schedule (guard: planned rotation).
Every credential inactive; the workbook judges credentials per schedule reference and per range and type.
Discovered services exist and svc_ci_assoc is empty; ITOM-068 is map coverage below 60%, ITOM-067 Business Critical services with no map above 10%. Also applicability evidence for Service Mapping.
A discovered service with no association; ITOM-074 is an application service with an entry point but zero mapped CIs.
Open ALERTS with no CI; ITOM-098 is EVENTS failing to bind (by node format) and ITOM-095 the binding success rate below 85%. Lives in platformRules() but routes to ITOM.
Availability (cmdb_ci_outage) is not in the ITOM sheet.
A ready ECC item older than a fixed 1 hour; ITOM-036 judges queue depth and oldest age, both configurable. Written under Performance, routed to ITOM by RULE_SCOPE.
Severity High vs Systemic.
Regex match on the script; the PLT-034 guard requires parsing, so a call inside a comment or string literal does not fire.
Severity High vs Critical. sys_rest_message only; PLT-144 covers any integration endpoint.
Any sys_trigger in error state; PLT-110 is a failure rate above 20% with no alerting or notification.
Every skipped update; PLT-154 is skipped updates from the LAST upgrade with no review disposition, ranked by execution volume.
Severity High/Moderate vs Critical. PLT-129 reports elevated roles separately from ordinary ones.
